about.heading: About the project
about.paragraph1: The Good Boy Foundation is dedicated to improving the lives of dogs in Žilina, Slovakia. We rescue abandoned, abused and stray dogs, and give them the medical care, shelter and love they deserve. Our mission is to give these loyal companions a second chance at life by finding them a loving home. Beyond rescue and rehabilitation, we also promote responsible pet ownership and animal welfare through education and community programmes.
about.paragraph2: Our work is made possible by passionate volunteers, generous donors and a community that cares deeply about animal welfare. We also run neutering and spaying initiatives to address the stray dog problem and secure a long-term impact. At the Good Boy Foundation we believe every dog deserves a safe, loving home and a happy life. Join us and help us make a difference — by volunteering, donating or adopting a furry friend. Together we can build a better future for the dogs of Žilina.
